title: WXJK's Simple Pocket Dimensions
description: This project adds 3 tiers of pocket dimensions that you can craft and enter. each player will have their own if they craft it.
body:
This datapack lets players craft and use a personal pocket dimension in the game. There are 3 tiers to the pocket dimensions. Small, Medium, And Large. The first time you enter your pocket dimension it comes with some decoration and there is more decoration as you get a bigger pocket dimension. To use a pocket dimension hold right click to start to use it will take 3 seconds to enter and you will see your progress in the action bar.

<details>
<summary>Pocket Dimension Crafting Recipies</summary>

A=Amethyst Shard\
B=Nether Quarts\
C=Diamond Block\
D=Chest\
E=Ender Chest\
F=Netherite Scrap\
G=Small Pocket Dimension\
H=Medium Pocket Dimension\
I=Nether Star\
J=Netherite Ingot\
\

[ADA]\

[AEA]

Medium Pocket Dimension:\
